title: Kennedy Space Center Master Plan Environmental Assessment
summary: NASA's 2026 environmental-assessment record evaluates a phased 20-year master-plan envelope for facility construction, demolition, renovation, and infrastructure upgrades at Kennedy Space Center.
key_findings: The assessment addresses flexible processing and launch capability, infrastructure, and sustainable facilities.
It evaluates a phased planning envelope rather than a single capital project.
The record does not commit NASA to fund or build every master-plan action.
why_it_matters: It adds the environmental planning layer behind Kennedy's long-range infrastructure direction.
ftfn_relevance: Connects the master plan to an official environmental review.
Identifies later project-tier decisions and funding as separate stages.
Supports portfolio-scale planning without inferring completed assets.
evidence_limits: The assessment is not a project appropriation, award, or construction record.
It does not establish acceptance, availability, missions, or measured outcomes.
